XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Vehicles manufactured up to 1 November 2019

  • System: Injection

  • Device: AdBlue control unit

  • Fault: AdBlue level fault warning

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following errors:
    • CD9612 (Communication problems between the SCR system and the injection control unit)

    • CD9613 (Communication problems between the SCR system and the injection control unit regarding monitoring of the SCR additive status)

    • CD9611 (Communication problems between the SCR system and the injection control unit regarding SCR system updates)

    • 29FB00 (SCR system shutdown: Level 1 alarm)

    • 29FC00 (SCR system shutdown: Level 2 alarm)
  • Cause: Inadequate AdBlue control unit software or damaged AdBlue control unit connector

• Action: Check the condition of the AdBlue control unit connector. If no faults are found, proceed with the AdBlue control unit software update

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: WARNING :
    • If there are any DTCs or symptomatic conditions other than those listed, resolve them before proceeding with this bulletin.

    • To carry out the update, the vehicle’s battery must be fully charged or supported by a battery charger or auxiliary battery to ensure a nominal voltage of 12V. Switch off all lights and accessories to prevent the battery from discharging
